title: Zymoclean Gel DNA Recovery Protocol
author: Zymo Research
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.gitbuen
materials: Ultra-pure DNA is now ready for use.

steps.title: Excise DNA fragment
steps.instruction: Excise the DNA fragment from the agarose gel using a razor blade, scalpel, or other device and transfer it into a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube, keeping the amount of excised agarose as small as possible.

steps.title: Add ADB buffer
steps.instruction: Add 3 volumes of ADB to each volume of agarose excised from the gel (e.g., for 100 μl of agarose gel slice, add 300 μl of ADB).

steps.title: Incubate and dissolve gel
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 37-55 °C for 5-10 minutes until the gel slice is completely dissolved. Do not incubate above 60°C.

substeps.instruction: Use gentle mixing during incubation to facilitate complete dissolution.

steps.title: Adjust volume for large fragments
steps.instruction: For DNA fragments > 8 kb, add one additional volume (equal to the volume of the gel slice) of water to the mixture following the incubation step to improve recovery (e.g., 100 μl agarose, 300 μl ADB, and 100 μl water).

steps.title: Load and centrifuge column
steps.instruction: Transfer the melted agarose solution to a Zymo-Spin™ Column in a Collection Tube and centrifuge for 30-60 seconds at 10,000 - 16,000 x g.

substeps.instruction: Discard the flow-through by aspiration, avoiding contamination of the collection tube rim.

steps.title: Wash DNA column
steps.instruction: Perform two wash steps using DNA Wash Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 μl of DNA Wash Buffer to the column and centrifuge for 30 seconds; discard the flow-through.
Add another 200 μl of DNA Wash Buffer to the column and centrifuge for 30 seconds; discard the flow-through.

steps.title: Apply elution buffer
steps.instruction: Add ≥ 6 μl of DNA Elution Buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.5, 0.1 mM EDTA) or water (pH >6.0) directly to the column matrix.

substeps.instruction: For fragments > 6 kb, wait 1 minute prior to elution to improve yield.
For fragments > 10 kb, use 60-70 ºC DNA Elution Buffer to improve total yield.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Place the column into a 1.5 ml tube and centrifuge for 30-60 seconds at 10,000 - 16,000 x g to elute the DNA.
